subject: SignalForge evaluation plan & commercial/payment path
messages:
From: Alex Turner <aturner@signalforge.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@signalforge.com
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial evaluation & procurement cadence

Rachel,

Thanks for the demo earlier — the team is keen to run a 6-week evaluation focused on latency and cost per token for our customer-facing summarization workflow. Before we kick off procurement needs to confirm a few items so we can map internal approvals:

- Evaluation milestones: pilot start, mid-eval review (week 3), acceptance criteria (week 6)
- Pricing/commits: what discounting looks like at 0-3M tokens vs 3-10M tokens
- Invoicing & PO: procurement needs billing cadence, whether Redwood requires a PO before the first invoice, and if Net30 is standard
- Billing start date: whether billing starts at pilot kickoff or after production acceptance

Can you send a short mutual action plan and a sample SOW with payment terms? Procurement prefers Net60 on first invoice while approvals finalize — is that something you can accommodate for the pilot?

Thanks,

Alex Turner
Head of Infrastructure
SignalForge
From: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
To: Alex Turner <aturner@signalforge.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial evaluation & procurement cadence

Alex — thanks for the clear list. Attached is a draft MAP and a sample SOW that maps milestones to billing triggers (SignalForge_MAP_v1.xlsx; Redwood_SOW_SF-042.pdf).

High level summary:
- MAP milestones: Kickoff (week 0), Mid-eval review (Wk3), Acceptance (Wk6). Acceptance = runbook + perf targets met on a 2-week rolling window.
- Pricing: Pilot rates are list price with a 10% evaluation credit applied to first invoice. Post-pilot committed pricing tiers: 3% discount >3M tokens/mo, 10% discount >10M tokens/mo (applied to committed baseline).
- Payment terms: Standard Net30. For this pilot we can offer Net60 on the first invoice (one-time) to accommodate procurement timelines; after that invoices will revert to Net30 unless we agree on a Net60 enterprise term in the SOW.
- PO requirement: We require a PO number prior to billing only for enterprise contracts; for pilot engagements we can invoice without a PO but will request PO for the paid contract conversion.
- Billing start: Billing can either start on pilot kickoff or be deferred until the 'acceptance' milestone per your preference. Note: deferring billing shifts Redwood's revenue recognition and requires a short addendum — fine for pilots but must be explicit in SOW.
- Ramp/discounts: Discounts are tied to committed baseline and ramp schedule in the MAP. We can include a time-bound ramp discount (5% off for the first 90 days if commit is met within that window).

Next steps: Ben will schedule a 30-min procurement sync to confirm PO process and finalize the MAP. Once procurement signs off we'll issue a short SOW with the agreed billing start and term.

Attachments:
- SignalForge_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones & acceptance criteria)
- Redwood_SOW_SF-042.pdf (sample SOW with payment term options)

Thanks,

Rachel Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Rachel/Ben — I reviewed the MAP and SOW. Approve offering the following anchor terms to close this pilot:

- One-time Net60 on first invoice only (to support procurement). After that invoices Net30.
- Include ramp incentive: 5% discount applied to invoices for the first 90 days if SignalForge reaches the committed baseline within that window.
- No upstream SLA concessions for pilot (standard hosted SLA applies).
- PO is preferred but not required for the pilot; require PO for conversion to paid committed contract.

Do not commit to any additional concessions beyond the above without my sign-off. Ben — if procurement pushes for deferred billing beyond Acceptance, escalate to me.
